name: Architecture Summer Academy
org: Kennesaw State University, College of Architecture and Construction Management
what_you_do: Two weeks of design practice in architecture. It includes a field trip to Atlanta. It ends with a talk about your work and an awards dinner.
who_can_apply: High school students of all levels. No ages or grades are listed.
pay_detail: $1,050 for 2026. Materials for modeling and drawing are included. Scholarships are not mentioned.
deadline_text: 2026 session July 6 to July 17, 2026. Registration closed April 1, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Register online when registration is open. In 2026 registration was closed and a waitlist form was on the page.
notes: Costs money, not a job. Contact doarch@kennesaw.edu. Kennesaw campus: 1000 Chastain Road, Kennesaw, GA 30144.
